title: Fully hybrid 18F-PSMA PET/MRI as one-stop approach for the diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer
official: Fully hybrid 18F-PSMA PET/MRI as one-stop approach for the diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer
summary:
Main objective: To determine the diagnostic accuracy of 18F-PSMA PET/MRI for the diagnosis of
clinically relevant prostate cancer
conditions: Patients with clinical suspicion of clinically relevant prostate cancer
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients 18 years of age or older, identified as suspects for clinically significant prostate cancer
2. Ability to undergo all protocol scrutiny
3. Ability to provide informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Previous diagnosis of prostate cancer
2. Contraindications to perform the MRI examination (e.g. claustrophobia, pacemaker, estimated GFR less than or equal to 50mls/min)
3. Contraindications to perform the prostate biopsy
